sanskrit_verse: समवेतैस्तु यत्प्राप्तं सर्वे तत्र समांशिनः । तत्पुत्रा विषमसमाः पितृभागहराः स्मृताः ॥ १८ ॥
transliteration: samavetais tu yat prāptaṃ sarve tatra samāṃśinaḥ | tatputrā viṣamasamāḥ pitṛbhāgaharāḥ smṛtāḥ || 18 ||
sph_interpretive_translation: When property is acquired collectively by a group, all participants hold equal shares; their sons inherit equally, without distinction of seniority or juniority.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority arises from participation in creation, not lineage alone
Causation is established through active contribution to acquisition
Capacity-based responsibility aligns with shared ownership at time of accrual
Restoration logic ensures continuity of collective equity across generations
Consciousness alignment requires recognition of equality inherent in simultaneous participation
executable_legal_axioms: IF asset acquired BY multiple parties IN joint action THEN each party OWNS equal undivided share
IF father participated EQUALLY in acquisition THEN son inherits EQUAL portion REGARDLESS of birth order
IF dispute arises OVER division THEN original mode of acquisition DETERMINES inheritance structure
IF heir claims GREATER share THEN proof must DEMONSTRATE unequal participation IN initial act
IF no such proof EXISTS THEN EQUAL partition IS default executable outcome
supreme_court_application: In matters concerning ancestral or jointly acquired property, the threshold of responsibility lies in demonstrable participation during the act of acquisition. Seniority or genealogical precedence does not confer greater right where all were co-participants. The court must restore balance by affirming equal distribution unless disproven by verifiable evidence of disproportionate involvement.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that simultaneous engagement constitutes shared causality. Anupūrvaśaḥ reveals that inheritance flows from the nature of origin, not temporal sequence. Proportional responsibility reflects actual contribution, not assumed hierarchy. The non-punitive reality rule upholds that no heir is diminished nor elevated beyond what was originally manifested through collective effort.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Completion Process: Reconstruct factual record of acquisition to validate equal participation
Responsibility Assumption Protocol: Require claimant asserting inequality to present irrefutable evidence
Capacity Restoration Measure: Reinstate equitable access to resources based on original causality
Integrity Reintegration Mechanism: Facilitate consensual redistribution aligned with proven contributions
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as the Sole Source of Dharma. This law restores equity among heirs according to true causality. There is no punishment—only alignment with the consciousness of sameness in which all rightful shares are realized.
